note: No copied full bodies, source excerpts, or screenshots are packaged. Locators refer to independently fetched bodies; inspection scope is stated and not inflated to complete proof review.

sources.title: Open Problems in Symbolic Dynamics
sources.date_evidence: PDF p.1 dates this version March 19, 2008; Ballier bibliography identifies Contemporary Mathematics 469 (2008), 69–118.
sources.inspection: Section 16 and its three problem statements read; not a proof audit of the complete survey.
sources.comparison: 16.3 specifies a given surjective self-code. 16.2 quantifies over a code and includes a receptive fixed point; 16.1 concerns stable CA limit sets.

sources.title: On Separation by Locally Testable and Locally Threshold Testable Languages
sources.date_evidence: Journal body p.1: submitted Nov.25,2013; published Sep.18,2014. arXiv v4 Sept.17,2014.
locators: pp.2–3: earlier decidable pointlikes and application discussion
sources.inspection: Complete 28-page body fetched and hashed; definitions, complete Theorem 4.2, corollary, introduction, conclusion and references read; body searched for sofic/steady/shift/application terms.
sources.comparison: General regular-language LT separability and explicit common-monoid k=4(|M|+1) are old. No prescribed map, SFT-neighborhood, or saturation-to-T[N] assertion located.

sources.title: On Separation by Locally Testable and Locally Threshold Testable Languages, arXiv v1
sources.date_evidence: arXiv submission Aug.1,2013; v1 body watermark agrees.
sources.inspection: Full v1 body fetched and hashed; complete relevant theorem and corollary read.
sources.comparison: Theorem 3 uses two monoids and k=4(|M1||M2|+1). Do not silently date the sharper common-monoid formulation in the candidate to this v1.

sources.title: Complete reducibility of the pseudovariety LSl
sources.date_evidence: Author postprint dated Feb.9,2009; institutional record dates 2009-02 and DOI 10.1142/S021819670900507X; journal 19 (2009), 247–282.
locators: author PDF pp.1–2: definitions, history and decidable pointlikes bridge
sources.inspection: Full 33-page author postprint fetched/hashed; introduction, exact theorem statements, and citation bridge read.
sources.comparison: General algebraic reducibility/tameness theorem for constrained equation systems. No concrete reduction from the prescribed extension problem to those equations is supplied in inspected text.

sources.title: Pseudovarieties defining classes of sofic subshifts closed for taking shift equivalent subshifts
sources.date_evidence: Institutional preprint05-31 received Dec.12,2005. Published title uses 'under taking'; JPAA209(2), May2007,517–530, DOI10.1016/j.jpaa.2006.06.016.
sources.inspection: Full 23-page primary preprint fetched/hashed; proposition, proof, introduction read; searched for separator/steady.
sources.comparison: An irreducible subshift with locally commutative syntactic semigroup is SFT, implying the familiar irreducible-LT/SFT membership connection. It does not characterize separation of L(T) from an independently defined bad ideal.

sources.title: The Karoubi envelope of the mirage of a subshift
sources.date_evidence: Institutional preprint20-17 received May15,2020. No later publication date is needed or asserted here.
locators: PDF pp.8–11: Example3.1, Theorem3.2, Remark3.3 and mirage definitions
sources.inspection: Full 53-page primary preprint fetched/hashed; introductory scope, complete relevant definitions/statements and selected block-code framework read; searched for separation and steady (no hits in web text).
sources.comparison: This is a substantive algebraic/symbolic bridge: local approximations, profinite closures and block codes. Its stated goals are conjugacy/flow invariants and zeta data; no specified steady-map decision criterion or canonical finite bound located.

sources.title: Limit sets of stable Cellular Automata
sources.date_evidence: arXiv v1 Jan.16,2013; Cambridge primary metadata: first online Oct.9,2013, ETDS35(3),May2015,673–690, DOI10.1017/etds.2013.72. The PDF's 'Received15thOctober2018' template line is inconsistent with those records and is not used as a priority date.
locators: PDF p.10 / printed p.9: steady-map definition
PDF p.11 / printed p.10: Lemma2.1, including SFT approximation normalization
PDF pp.13–14 / printed pp.12–13: Lemma3.1 and Theorem3.2
sources.inspection: Full 18-page arXiv body fetched/hashed; definitions, the named complete statements and surrounding proofs, concluding questions and references read.
sources.comparison: Steadiness and use of canonical SFT approximations predate the candidate. Main equivalences restrict closing/continuing properties and quantify existence of suitable maps; they do not decide every prescribed map or supply the LT/bad-ideal criterion.

sources.title: Efficient Separability of Regular Languages by Subsequences and Suffixes
sources.date_evidence: arXiv submission Mar.5,2013; primary institutional publication page: ICALP2013,LNCS7966,150–161, DOI10.1007/978-3-642-39212-2_16. PDF template prints Nov.3,2018 and is not used as original date.
sources.inspection: Full 31-page primary body fetched/hashed; introduction, full Theorem3 and relevant class definitions read.
sources.comparison: Separators use subsequences/suffixes and WQO hypotheses. Factor containment on A* is not WQO (0 1^m 0 form an antichain); no direct plug-in proves the desired LT/SFT reduction.

sources.title: Adding successor: A transfer theorem for separation and covering
sources.date_evidence: arXiv1709.10052 submitted Sept.28,2017; inspected author manuscript has March2019 template footer. Author's publication page places journal in ACM TOCL21(2),2020; DOI10.1145/3356339. ACM landing access failed403; no precise journal online day asserted.
locators: p.37: Theorem7.6 and Corollary7.8 for one-sided omega words
sources.inspection: Full 44-page author manuscript fetched/hashed; exact relevant statements and introduction read.
sources.comparison: Transfers separation/covering under successor enrichment, with finite-word and omega-word variants. These are general regular-language theorems; the two-sided subshift-extension application and saturation remain unprovided in inspected statements.

sources.title: Computational complexity of problems for deterministic presentations of sofic shifts
sources.date_evidence: arXiv first submitted Dec.7,2021; primary journal metadata TCS936,Nov.10,2022,92–115, DOI10.1016/j.tcs.2022.09.017.
sources.inspection: Full 39-page primary body fetched/hashed; decision-problem table, exact relevant theorems and surrounding algorithm text read.
sources.comparison: Decides SFT membership, inclusion and related presentation properties; applies to a fixed T[n] test and to identity-map controls. It does not decide the existential n for general prescribed F.

sources.title: An Algebraic Characterisation of First-Order Logic with Neighbour
sources.date_evidence: arXiv first May19,2021; inspected author PDF copyright2021IEEE. Conference DOI10.1109/LICS52264.2021.9470660. A secondary portal's2024date is not treated as first publication.
locators: author PDF pp.1–3: logic definitions and main characterization scope
pp.5–9: locally hermitian product and characterization
sources.inspection: Full 13-page author body fetched/hashed; main scope, definitions and selected complete theorem statements read.
sources.comparison: An indexed citer of PRZ; finite-word neighbor logic and involution algebra, with no prescribed shift-map extension criterion located.

sources.title: A package TESTAS for checking some kinds of testability
sources.date_evidence: The body and arXiv metadata identify original LNCS2608(2003),228–232; arXiv uploadMay26,2021. Do not confuse upload with theorem date.
locators: PDF pp.1–2: membership problem and algorithms
pp.3–4: testability checks and order bounds
sources.inspection: Full 6-page arXiv body fetched/hashed; scope and algorithm statements read.
sources.comparison: Membership and fixed-order testability algorithms, rather than arbitrary-pair LT separation or the specified-map extension reduction.

sources.title: Measure-Theoretic Aspects of Star-Free and Group Languages
sources.date_evidence: arXiv2506.14134v1,Jun.17,2025. The body retains CVIT2016/sample-DOI template fields; those are not publication dates or valid claimed article DOI here.
sources.inspection: Full 14-page arXiv body fetched/hashed; definitions, exact named statements and citation trail to LT-measurability read.
sources.comparison: Density approximation is weaker than exact bad-ideal disjointness. The even-shift control in COMPARISON.md makes the distinction checkable.

sources.title: Exact Local Annotations for Regular Languages
sources.inspection: Full 24-page primary arXiv body fetched/hashed; complete relevant model definitions/statements read; not an independent validation of that paper's own research claims.
sources.comparison: Edit stability of auxiliary finite-word annotations; its strict-local membership statement does not characterize prescribed block-code steadiness or stable CA limit sets.
